term: sufficient reason for a fact or true statement
definition: In Monadology §32 the reason answers why a real/existing fact or a true statement is so rather than otherwise. The demand is not restricted to reasons known by us. This explanatory norm is broader than a predecessor assignment and is not identified with efficient causation, a reason token, or a generated-warrant derivation.
